title: KNAB to investigate ZZS handing out booze
summary_full: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will investigate an incident in which the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) gave bottles of black balsam to senior citizens, KNAB said on September 18. This week, on the Latvian Radio programme “Krustpunktā”, a listener asked ZZS MP Augusts Brigmanis to comment on the fact that, at a seniors’ gathering in Ogre on 23 August, the ZZS had given small souvenirs to senior citizens, including a “small bottle of black balsam” bearing the ZZS’s list number for the forthcoming Saeima elections.
